The game itself is in Finnish. Play it in the browser at
[lukuloitsu.fi](https://lukuloitsu.fi), or download the Windows version below.
`lukuloitsu-opas.pdf` is the printable user booklet (in Finnish): how the
system works, examples, and all the pairs with their pictures.

**Windows:** unzip `lukuloitsu-windows.zip` and run `lukuloitsu.exe`. The
program isn't code-signed, so Chrome may warn about the download (choose
**Keep**) and Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" (choose
**More info**, then **Run anyway**). You can also build it yourself; see the
README.
